additional_info.subject: RE: ID0371671-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R6 170002150] Q2310-Display Delamination CRM:00579000987
additional_info.body:
Hi Yunus,
Greetings of the day!
Please note that, unless we get the proper images we will not be able to suggest you with the correct Q-feedback.
Also, please confirm if the HMI is of Gen1 or Gen2 ? Then accordingly we will suggest you further.
If it has Gen 2 HMI, then Q-feedback doesn't apply and hence repair has to be carried out separately.
But based on your statement, as the HMI is completely black then you need to check with the electrical connections first. To check the connections, you can refer Q-feedback. If everything is working well, then you can move forward with replacing HMI.
Please ensure you collect both the ‘before’ and ‘after’ pictures of the onsite activity
. Kindly attach these images to the service report.
Do let us know, if you have any other further queries.
Thank you,
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vaishnavi Raut
